name: bridgerow-ops-dashboard
description: Read-only Bridgerow operations dashboard: agent activity, projects, website, social media, content pipeline, offers and usage, with sources and freshness.

driveServer.title: Google Drive connector
driveServer.description: The MCP server name of the Google Drive connector, as /mcp lists it.

workAccount.title: Work Drive account
workAccount.description: Only Drive items owned by this account are read; anything else is refused.

bridgerowFolderId.title: Bridgerow folder ID
bridgerowFolderId.description: Canonical Work Drive ID of ELIA OS/PROJECTS/Bridgerow (CURRENT_STATE and DECISIONS are read from it).

paliosFolderId.title: Palios folder ID
paliosFolderId.description: Work Drive ID of the folder holding Palios records. Empty means not configured.

paliosDocTitles.title: Palios documents
paliosDocTitles.description: Comma-separated titles of the documents to read in the Palios folder.

danceAlchemyFolderId.title: Dance Alchemy folder ID
danceAlchemyFolderId.description: Work Drive ID of the folder holding Dance Alchemy records. Empty means not configured.

danceAlchemyDocTitles.title: Dance Alchemy documents
danceAlchemyDocTitles.description: Comma-separated titles of the documents to read in the Dance Alchemy folder.

approvedSharedIds.title: Approved shared Drive IDs
approvedSharedIds.description: Comma-separated IDs of files or folders owned by another account that may be read when found in a configured folder. Anything else not owned by the Work account is shown as NOT APPROVED and not read.

contentFolderId.title: Content folder ID
contentFolderId.description: Work Drive ID of ELIA OS/PROJECTS/Bridgerow/Content. Day folders are read from Publishing/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD inside it. Empty means not configured.

contentCalendarDocId.title: Content calendar document ID
contentCalendarDocId.description: Work Drive ID of the current content calendar. Empty means not configured.

contentCalendarStartDate.title: Content calendar start date
contentCalendarStartDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the calendar's Day 1, used to find today's ideas. Empty means today's ideas are shown as unknown.

socialAccounts.title: Social accounts
socialAccounts.description: Comma-separated platform=handle pairs, for example instagram=@bridgerow_solutions,tiktok=@name. Shown next to each platform as set here; they are not verified with the platform.

websiteRepo.title: Website repository
websiteRepo.description: owner/repo of the Bridgerow website on GitHub.

websiteBranch.title: Website branch
websiteBranch.description: Branch the website is built from.

websiteUrl.title: Public website URL
websiteUrl.description: The site's public https address. When set, each refresh checks it once (status, response time, page title). Empty means not checked.

posthogProjectId.title: PostHog project ID
posthogProjectId.description: The PostHog project whose web analytics are shown (aggregates only: visitors, pageviews, top pages, traffic sources). Read through the PostHog connector with read-only queries; the connector's active project must be this one. Empty means not configured.

posthogServer.title: PostHog connector name
posthogServer.description: Name of the PostHog MCP server in Claude Code.

zernioServer.title: Zernio connector name
zernioServer.description: Name of the Zernio MCP server in Claude Code, as /mcp lists it. Followers, views and engagement are read from it with three read-only tools (accounts_list, accounts_get_follower_stats, analytics_get_analytics); nothing is posted, scheduled or changed. Empty means not configured.

contentEngineDir.title: Content engine folder (optional)
contentEngineDir.description: Local path of the ai-content-engine checkout, read with git log only. Empty means not configured.

staleDays.title: Days before a record is stale
staleDays.description: An ELIA OS document not updated for this many days is flagged STALE.
